items.q: Where do your fees and requirements come from?
items.a: Only from the university's official website, published fee schedules and admissions documents, or Ukrainian government sources. Each fact shows its status (verified or pending) and the date we last checked it.

items.q: Why are some facts marked “to be confirmed”?
items.a: Because we have not yet verified them from an official source. We would rather show a gap than an invented or outdated figure. If you need that fact now, start an application and we will confirm it with you.

items.q: Are fees in different currencies or years comparable?
items.a: Not directly. We always show the academic year and currency, and we never merge different years or programme types into one figure.

items.q: Do you use real photos of each university?
items.a: On a university profile we use images from the university's official sources where we are allowed to. Generic stock photography is never presented as a specific campus, and every image is credited with its source and licence.
